title: BlackRock holds 123,056 Strategy shares ahead of MSCI exit, but how much must it sell?
summary: When you buy an index fund, you're paying a manager to follow a particular group of stocks. MSCI creates these indexes and sets their membership rules, while companies such as BlackRock manage the funds that follow them. MSCI is removing Strategy from several of its indexes after Nov. 30.
